title: Carrusel para Redes Sociales: Guía de 9 Poses Favorecedoras para Fotografía en la Playa
prompt: Create an engaging Twitter/X carousel-style image showing beach photography tips. Layout: Grid of 3x3 panels showcasing different flattering beach poses. Each panel features a silhouette or minimal illustration of a person in an elegant pose against ocean backdrop. Poses emphasize: walking into water, looking over shoulder, sitting with legs extended, jumping, candid laugh, hat adjustment, flowing dress twirl, sunset silhouette, reflections in wet sand. Modern flat illustration style with gradient sunset colors (coral pink, golden orange, deep purple). Clean typography with pose tips in English. Top banner text: '9 beach poses that look professional 🌊'. Bottom text: 'save this before your next trip'. Vibrant color palette optimized for social media engagement. Minimalist icons and numbered callouts. Square format perfect for Twitter/X image posts.
